releases.notes:
## Wynn Weapon Bigger 1.1.1

Ctrl+C image sharing is gone in favor of Wynntils' own sharing, and tooltips are no longer covered by the zoomed item.

### Removed
- **Ctrl+C image sharing.** Wynntils already does this with its Screenshot Item key, so the mod no longer has its own share key, toasts or sharing options (After Ctrl+C, Read All Tooltip Pages First)

### Changed
- The share hint under the preview now shows your Wynntils keys: **Share Item** (links the item in chat) and **Screenshot Item** (takes an image of its tooltip). Each line is hidden if that key is unbound or its Wynntils feature is turned off
- The share hint's lines now fade in one at a time, carrying on from the text above them (the card body or the floating header), instead of all at once after a delay

### Fixed
- Tooltips are no longer covered by the zoomed item, card or share hint. They now always draw on top

releases.notes:
## Wynn Weapon Bigger 1.1.0

Adds an item card display mode and Ctrl+C image sharing, and makes Cloth Config and Mod Menu optional.

### New
- **Item Card mode**: the zoomed item now sits inside a Wynncraft-style card with every ID, roll % and roll bar (in your Wynntils colors), powders, rerolls, shiny stat and Nori/Wynnpool scales
- Perfect rolls get a flowing rainbow frame and defective rolls get grey static
- **Floating item mode** (the default) shows the item's name, overall roll %, and rarity/type/element/major ID badges under the model instead of the raw tooltip text
- **Ctrl+C to share as an image**: hover any item in any inventory and press Ctrl+C (Cmd+C on macOS) to render its full card to a PNG, copy it to your clipboard and save it to `screenshots/`. It reads the tooltip pages you haven't looked at (powders etc.) first, the same way Wynntils' chat share does
- Small print under the preview shows your share keys (Wynntils' Share Item key for chat, Ctrl+C for an image). You can turn it off, and it never shows up in shared images
- New options: display mode, how many IDs the card shows, powders/rerolls, shiny stat, scales, frame effects, copy and/or save when sharing, and the text cascade

### Changed
- Cloth Config and Mod Menu are now **optional**. Every setting lives in the config file, and without Cloth Config `/wwb config` shows you where it is
- The config file is now `config/wynnweaponbigger.json` to match the mod's name. Your 1.0.0 `wynn_weapon_viewer.json` is renamed automatically and carries over with the new options added, and a broken config file falls back to defaults instead of crashing (the old one is kept as `.broken`)
- Reworked config screen: General, Display, Animations and Items, with readable names, sliders with units, and options that grey out when they don't apply
- Commands are now just `/wwb`: `/wwb` (help, click a command to type it), `/wwb toggle`, `/wwb config`, `/wwb reload`. The old `/WynnWeaponBigger`, `/wwb on` and `/wwb off` are gone
- Requires Wynntils 4.2.18+ and Fabric Loader 0.18.4+

### Fixed
- Fixed a startup crash
- Fixed the toggle key doing nothing on the first press when the mod started disabled
- The Corkian Amplifiers filter is back (it was lost in the 1.0 rewrite)

releases.notes:
### Highlights

This is a major rewrite of the mod. The rendering system has been completely overhauled to use Minecraft 1.21.11's PictureInPicture GPU rendering, resulting in much better visual quality and smoother performance.

---

### New Features

**Appear Animations**
Choose how the item preview appears when you hover over an item:
- `NONE` - instant
- `FADE` - fades in (default)
- `SCALE` - scales up from nothing
- `SLIDE_LEFT`, `SLIDE_RIGHT`, `SLIDE_TOP`, `SLIDE_BOTTOM` - slides in from a direction

**Idle Animations**
Optional animations while hovering:
- `SWING` - gentle rocking
- `PULSE` - subtle breathing scale

**Item Info Text**
The item name and stats now appear below the preview after a configurable delay. Text size scales proportionally with the zoom level. The item name can optionally be shown above the preview instead of below.

**Appear Delay**
Configurable delay (0–1000ms) before the item preview appears, so it doesn't flash on every quick mouse movement.

---

### Configuration Changes

All settings are available through Mod Menu.

| Setting | Default | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| `appearAnimation` | FADE | Animation style when preview appears |
| `idleAnimation` | NONE | Animation while hovering |
| `appearDelayMs` | 250 | Delay before preview appears (ms) |
| `showItemInfo` | true | Show item name and stats |
| `infoDelaySeconds` | 0 | Delay before item info appears (seconds) |
| `itemNameAbove` | false | Show item name above preview instead of below |

All existing settings (`scale`, `horizontalAlignment`, `xOffset`, `yOffset`, `enableWeapons`, etc.) are preserved from v0.x.

---

### Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Requires Wynntils
- Requires Fabric API, Cloth Config

---

### Credits & Attributions

- **Big Items, Duh** — the original mod this project was forked from
- **ItemZoomer** by iMeeTake — the rendering system the v1.0 rewrite is based on
- **Wynntils** — item detection and lore utilities that make this mod possible
- Special thanks to **Igbarvonsquid**!!!!!
